originalTitle: Horizon Industrial Parks sets IPO price band at Rs 57-60 for Rs 2,600 crore issue. Check key dates
simplifiedContent: Horizon Industrial Parks is planning to sell shares to the public for the first time, in a process called an Initial Public Offering (IPO). The company has set a price range of Rs 57 to Rs 60 per share, and hopes to raise Rs 2,600 crore. The IPO will be open for investors to buy shares from August 17 to August 19. The company plans to use the money it raises to pay off debts. This matters because it's an opportunity for individual investors to buy shares in the company, and also helps the company to reduce its debt.
